en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a grand historic riverside hotel set against a forested hillside. The ornate multi‑storey building bears the sign "Grand Hôtel Pupp" on its façade, with a flag flying from the roof. In the foreground there is a river, a bridge, and a riverside promenade with railings. The lower margin contains printed captions identifying the place and publisher.
